content:
Editor's Guide: Ambition Mechanical - Primrose (Senior Living HVAC)

Date of Shoot: September 23, 2025 Organized: March 11, 2026 Source: /Volumes/SS8TB/Ambition Mechanical Services/20250923_Primrose/

Overview

Single-location shoot at Primrose, a senior living facility. Three camera sources: Ronin4D cinema camera (ProRes 4K), iPhone 4K (HEVC), and DJI drone (H.264 4K). Heavy coverage across all three, with 104 total files including proxies.

Source Clips Format Total Duration
Cinema (Ronin4D) 15 ProRes 4K 24fps ~12.7 min
iPhone 34 HEVC 4K 24fps ~20.8 min
Drone 3 H.264 4K 30fps ~9.4 min
Total 52 -- ~42.9 min

Location Context

Primrose is a senior living community in Phoenix/Scottsdale. Senior living HVAC is specialized work: these facilities require precise temperature control, superior air quality, and redundant systems to protect elderly residents. HVAC service at a senior living facility is higher-stakes than standard commercial work because the residents depend on it for health and safety. This is the same type of work shown in the Memorial Tower footage from the March 2026 shoot, reinforcing Ambition's expertise in this vertical.

Story angle: Ambition takes care of the people who can't take care of themselves. Senior living HVAC isn't just comfort; it's safety. The combination of talking shots, detailed b-roll, and aerial coverage tells the full story of the job scope.

Edit Recommendations

60s Social Reel (Instagram / LinkedIn)

  • Open: DJI_0041 (building aerial, pick best 3s) or A001C0011 (establishing)
  • :05-:15: A001C0025 pull quote (select best 10s of the 3:14 hero clip)
  • :15-:30: Process montage from A001C0015, C0016, C0019
  • :30-:40: iPhone detail rapid-fire (IMG_5158-5163 sequence, quick cuts)
  • :40-:50: A001C0013 or C0017 talking continuation
  • :50-:60: DJI_0042 wide pull-back as closer

30s IG Reel (High Energy)

  • Speed ramp A001C0015 process footage
  • Cut through IMG quick details (4-5 clips, 1-2s each)
  • One strong A001C0025 pull quote (3s)
  • End on drone DJI_0040

Long-form Case Study (2-3 min)

  • A001C0025 as spine (3:14 of interview/walkthrough)
  • Cut between talking and matching b-roll
  • iPhone BTS (IMG_5188 at 6:29) for behind-the-scenes angles
  • Drone as chapter breaks
  • Detail shots as interstitials

Gap Analysis: What's Missing

  1. No lav mic audio found in this folder. Talking shots rely on camera mic only. Check if DJI Mic audio was stored separately.
  2. iPhone clips need review on actual content. Duration-based classification is approximate. Some "long" iPhone clips may be BTS rather than talking. Needs visual confirmation.
  3. No photos found in this folder. The S5iiX photos that are in the 0924 Dintai folder may have Primrose stills mixed in (separate shoot the next day).
  4. No finished product shots. Work-in-progress footage only.
  5. No client/facility manager testimonial.
  6. No before/after documentation.
